page.overview:
Who is Giichi?

At some point in the past, he met Agari and married her. Unable to have children, Agari sees Inari as if he were her own.

Giichi used to be cowardly as seen when he refused to help build the bridge anymore because of Gatō. Later, after he saw how brave Inari was, he overcame his cowardly self and rallied others to attack Gatō's men. His wife, Agari also had some influence over his decision to help Inari.

Giichi is an older man with black eyes and shaggy grey hair. He wears a greenish-coloured T-shirt.

He initially helps build the Great Naruto Bridge, but leaves the job for fear of retaliation by Gatō. Inari later asks for his help in freeing the Land of Waves from Gatō. He refuses, but after realising how brave Inari is, he rallies the townspeople to help Inari.
